title: David Dances Before the Lord
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who stops to wonder, and tonight David dances before the Lord with all his might: Wren twirls and sings in a field of flowers that opened overnight, and does not stop when the neighbor laughs.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because wonder makes her want to praise. In Wren’s world today: Wren steps outside after a spring rain and sees a whole field of yellow flowers that opened overnight. She is so happy that she twirls and twirls in the grass with her arms out wide, singing a song she makes up on the spot. Her neighbor laughs, and Wren just waves and keeps on twirling. Just like David dancing before the Lord, Wren learned that a full heart does not have to hide its joy.
